archive_audit.interpretation: historical defect diagnosis only; not new scientific performance evidence

reexecution.reason: the local archive preserves final GP parameter snapshots and search responses but not the frozen target-response ledger or a directly loadable surrogate object

defect.explanation: the first convergence comparison used the raw-start score and the pre-update score at the same state, forcing every restart to terminate after its first Adam update

implementation.best_state_policy: best finite non-worsening post-update state per restart; otherwise best finite raw fallback
implementation.convergence_policy: compare raw-start with first post-update score and then successive post-update scores
